integrations.name: Market Rate Source
integrations.purpose: Provide a reference/mid-market exchange rate to seed or validate manually-set buy/sell rates.

integrations.name: Remittance Network Partner
integrations.purpose: Send or receive cross-border transfers on behalf of the exchange business's customers.

integrations.name: Identity Verification Provider
integrations.purpose: Verify a customer's identity document (and, where used, a liveness/biometric check) during customer due diligence, instead of relying only on a visual check at the counter.

provenance.notes: FATF R.10 requires identification and verification using reliable independent source documents or data; outsourcing that to a provider is common practice, not a requirement. Vendors named as examples only.

integrations.name: Sanctions / PEP Watchlist Screening
integrations.purpose: Screen customer and beneficiary names against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media lists, and re-screen on list updates.
examples: OFAC SDN and Consolidated Sanctions lists

provenance.notes: FATF R.6/R.7 require targeted financial sanctions screening; the published lists are the authoritative data. Whether it is bought or self-hosted is the product's choice.

integrations.name: Bank Transfer Rail
integrations.purpose: Move settlement funds and remittance payouts over a bank payment rail, and ingest the resulting statement for reconciliation.

provenance.notes: ISO 20022 defines the message set and NACHA the ACH file format; moov-io/ach and moov-io/iso20022 are Apache-2.0 implementations of both. A bureau that only handles physical cash may use none of these.

integrations.name: Accounting / General Ledger
integrations.purpose: Post daily takings, margin, commission, and settlement variances into the books, so the exchange system is not the accounting system of record.
examples: a CSV/journal export into any GL

provenance.notes: chfx-odoo-modules sits inside an accounting suite, so the posting is implicit; blnk shows the double-entry side. A file export is the low end of this integration and is near-universal.
